<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_NightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NightRunApp" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_NightRun">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Participate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Run5km</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TransportJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunRace</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DrinkWhileRunning</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadget" name="Fitness Gadget">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeasureTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_App" name="App">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CalculateTimeLeft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeLeft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Finished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participate" name="Want to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRun5km</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRun5km</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainToRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToMeasure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeasureTime" name="Measure 5 km time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToMeasure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MeasureToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck" name="Less than 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotUnder25">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MeasureToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under25</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Train" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotUnder25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainToRun</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCalcTimeLeft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateTimeLeft" name="Determine time left between start and workday end">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCalcTimeLeft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTimeLeftGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeLeft" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTimeLeftGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go there from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HomeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WorkToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TransportJoin" name="Transport decided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HomeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WorkToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRaceSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceSplit" name="Start race">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRaceSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToRun</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RunRace" name="Run the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceJoin" name="Race completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Finished" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRun5km" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToMeasure" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeasureToCheck" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under25" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${runningTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotUnder25" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainToRun" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCalcTimeLeft" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CalculateTimeLeft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTimeLeftGateway" sourceRef="Task_CalculateTimeLeft" targetRef="Gateway_TimeLeft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoFromHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeLeft" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${timeLeftMinutes > 60}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveFromWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeLeft" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HomeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TransportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WorkToJoin" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TransportJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRaceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TransportJoin" targetRef="Gateway_RaceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_RunRace"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunRace" targetRef="Gateway_RaceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="Task_DrinkWhileRunning" targetRef="Gateway_RaceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReceiveTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_Finished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
